221:     pub async fn authenticate(
222:         &self,
223:         authorization: &HeaderValue,
224:     ) -> Result<DavSession, CaldavAuthError> {
225:         let (username, password) =
226:             parse_basic_authorization(authorization).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
227:         let username = username.to_ascii_lowercase();
228:         let token = SecretToken::parse(&password).ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
229:         let token_prefix = password
230:             .chars()
231:             .take(TOKEN_PREFIX_LENGTH)
232:             .collect::<String>();
233:         let user_id: Option<i64> = sqlx::query_scalar(
234:             "SELECT id FROM users WHERE normalized_email = ? AND status = 'active'",
235:         )
236:         .bind(&username)
237:         .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
238:         .await
239:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
240:         let candidates: Vec<(i64, Vec<u8>)> = match user_id {
241:             Some(user_id) => sqlx::query_as(
242:                 "SELECT id, token_hash FROM caldav_credentials
243:                  WHERE user_id = ? AND token_prefix = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
244:             )
245:             .bind(user_id)
246:             .bind(&token_prefix)
247:             .fetch_all(&self.pool)
248:             .await
249:             .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
250:             None => Vec::new(),
251:         };
252:         let principal_id: Option<String> = match user_id {
253:             Some(user_id) => {
254:                 sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT principal_id FROM caldav_accounts WHERE user_id = ?")
255:                     .bind(user_id)
256:                     .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
257:                     .await
258:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?
259:             }
260:             None => None,
261:         };
262:         let mut verified: Option<i64> = None;
263:         let mut checked_candidate = false;
264:         for (credential_id, token_hash) in &candidates {
265:             checked_candidate = true;
266:             let expected = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes(
267:                 token_hash
268:                     .as_slice()
269:                     .try_into()
270:                     .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?,
271:             );
272:             if self
273:                 .key
274:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &expected)
275:             {
276:                 verified = Some(*credential_id);
277:                 break;
278:             }
279:         }
280:         if !checked_candidate {
281:             // Verify against a dummy hash so unknown-user, unknown-prefix, and
282:             // wrong-password failures take comparable time and do not reveal
283:             // which lookup failed.
284:             let dummy = crate::security::TokenHash::from_bytes([0_u8; 32]);
285:             let _ = self
286:                 .key
287:                 .verify_token(TokenDomain::CaldavConnection, &token, &dummy);
288:         }
289:         let credential_id = verified.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
290:         let principal_id = principal_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
291:         let user_id = user_id.ok_or(CaldavAuthError::InvalidCredentials)?;
292:         let now = (self.clock)();
293:         sqlx::query(
294:             "UPDATE caldav_credentials SET last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND revoked_at IS NULL",
295:         )
296:         .bind(now)
297:         .bind(credential_id)
298:         .execute(&self.pool)
299:         .await
300:         .map_err(|_| CaldavAuthError::Persistence)?;
301:         Ok(DavSession {
302:             user_id,
303:             credential_id,
304:             principal_id,
305:         })
306:     }

494: fn parse_basic_authorization(authorization: &HeaderValue) -> Option<(String, String)> {
495:     let encoded = authorization.to_str().ok()?;
496:     let (scheme, credentials) = encoded.split_once(' ')?;
497:     if !scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("basic") {
498:         return None;
499:     }
500:     let decoded = STANDARD.decode(credentials).ok()?;
501:     let string = String::from_utf8(decoded).ok()?;
502:     let (username, password) = string.split_once(':')?;
503:     if username.is_empty() || password.is_empty() {
504:         return None;
505:     }
506:     Some((username.to_owned(), password.to_owned()))
507: }
